name: bettersearch-eval
description: Hand-labelled queries for measuring retrieval quality. Deliberately weighted towards phrasings a user would actually type - questions, descriptions and concept names - rather than terms lifted from the documents, because searching for words that are already in the text is the case keyword search already handles.
caveat: These labels and the seed corpus were written by the same author, so treat the absolute numbers as indicative and the mode-to-mode gaps as the signal. Re-run against scripts/fetch_wikipedia.py output for a non-circular check.

queries.query: Norman conquest
queries.note: The headline case. No document contains this phrase.
A bare year - keyword search can only match documents that print it.

queries.note: Descriptive phrasing; the word 'maiden' appears nowhere.
